rationale.conceptual: The paper applies standard DFT (FP-LAPW, GGA/LDA) to known crystal structures; no new algorithm is introduced. Reproducing it with another DFT code (Quantum ESPRESSO) requires routine domain knowledge and correct parameter selection, fitting the 'standard method with minor variation' anchor.
rationale.execution: The workflow involves sequential steps: volume relaxation and EOS fitting for four compounds (each requiring multiple SCF runs at different volumes), equilibrium SCF, band structure/DOS calculation, and parameter extraction. This multi-stage pipeline with dependencies and non-trivial DFT convergence considerations aligns with the 'multi-stage pipeline (~4-6 stages)' anchor.
